input.reasoning:
Backlog totals 203 story points across 24 tasks. No historical velocity/actuals exist for this team, so I converted points to hours using an industry-typical planning heuristic of ~7 hours/point of total engineering effort (blended across roles), then allocated that effort across roles based on task nature (backend-heavy, frontend-heavy, integration, data, infra, QA, DevOps). This is a rough-order-of-magnitude estimate given the absence of actuals.

Role allocation logic per task type:
- Backend Developer: API/business logic, auth, RBAC, payments, migration, audit, email service, search, multi-currency, rate limiting - the largest share of backend-heavy tasks.
- Frontend Developer: UI-heavy tasks - design system, dashboards, invoice views, accessibility, responsive layout, admin back-office, analytics.
- QA Engineer: testing effort scaled at ~20-25% of dev effort per task, concentrated on high-risk items (payments, RBAC, migration, 2FA, accessibility, contract tests).
- DevOps Engineer: CI/CD, observability, decommissioning, infra-related slices of migration and rate limiting.

Capacity check: Backend Developer 1.5 FTE ≈ 2,400 hrs over a ~6 month (26 week) delivery window at 60 hrs/week combined capacity; Frontend 1.0 FTE ≈ 1,040 hrs/6mo; QA 0.6 FTE ≈ 624 hrs/6mo; DevOps 0.4 FTE ≈ 416 hrs/6mo. Allocated hours below stay within these envelopes, though Backend and QA are tightly loaded relative to the backlog size, and DevOps is thin for the number of infra-touching tasks (CI, observability, migration infra, decommission, rate limiting) — flagged as a risk in assumptions.

Priority breakdown computed by summing per-task fully loaded cost (proportional labour split) grouped by priority label.

Cost-reduction options identified: descoping/deferring Low-priority items (Support ticket submission, Admin back-office, Usage analytics, Contract tests, Decommission legacy portal) which together carry meaningful points but low business urgency; trimming QA hours on lower-risk Medium items by relying more on automated regression; deferring multi-currency to a later phase since it's Medium priority but high complexity (13 points) and not urgent.
